platforms.name: Viki · free episodes

platforms.evidence: Official Viki episode listing and https://api.viki.io/v4/series/41705c/episodes.json?app=100000a&per_page=50 show US geo=false, paywall=false, upcoming=false and English subtitles 100% for Episodes 1–6. This is a US listing check, not a purchase or playback guarantee.

platforms.name: Viki · Viki Pass episodes
platforms.evidence: Official Viki episode data from a US connection show geo=false, paywall=true, upcoming=false and English subtitles 100% for Episodes 7–33. The page also displays 35 episode tiles while the API lists 33 released episodes; do not count future tiles as playable.

platforms.name: WeTV · English-language listing
platforms.conflict: WeTV's 'All 47 EPs' label is catalog length, not proof that 47 subtitled episodes can be played in the US or another country. Search labels say English subtitles, but player/region access was not established.
platforms.evidence: Official WeTV English series listing only. No country-specific episode or subtitle guarantee.

history.note: Initial listing review: Viki showed 33 released episodes versus 35 episode tiles; WeTV said All 47 EPs. Country-specific access not checked.
